definitions.explanation: A piece cut out of a newspaper or magazine, typically an article, photograph, or recipe, saved for reference or collection.

definitions.gloss: a short clip or highlight (from video or audio)
definitions.explanation: A short segment extracted from a longer video or audio recording, such as a highlight reel or a fan-made excerpt from a livestream, widely shared on social media.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}く→切り抜く：06054_kirinuku⟧ (to cut out). Traditionally refers to newspaper or magazine clippings physically cut from print media. In modern usage, especially online, it refers to short video clips extracted from longer content such as livestreams or podcasts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き: newspaper clipping
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き: article clipping
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き: video clip
- {切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect clippings

CULTURAL NOTE:
In online culture, {切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き videos (short highlight clips from longer livestreams) have become extremely popular on platforms like YouTube, often made by fans of streamers and content creators.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スクラップ→スクラップ：12832_sukurappu⟧: scrapbook clipping — specifically for pasting into a scrapbook
- ⟦{抜粋|ばっすい}→抜粋：15277_bassui⟧: excerpt — more formal, usually refers to text excerpts
